title: PowerSync
context: Local-first data sync — real-time, offline, reactive. Postgres to SQLite sync. Could be the backbone of the architecture.

title: omnivore
context: Open-source read-it-later app — competitor research. Good execution but fundamentally a filing cabinet. Saves things, doesn't understand them.

title: linkwarden
context: Bookmark management with AI tagging — competitor research. Auto-tags are shallow. Knows it's an 'article about AI' but not WHY you saved it.

title: mymind — the extension for your mind
context: AI-powered bookmarking, auto-tagging, visual search. Pretty but shallow. Finds things, doesn't connect them.

title: Raindrop.io — all-in-one bookmark manager
context: Polished UX, good collections, but just a filing cabinet. You organize it, it stores it. No intelligence.

title: Cross-platform memory integration for Claude
context: Tried to retrofit the exoskeleton onto existing tools before building it. Used Claude Projects as a memory layer. Works but fragile.

title: Not enough time for everything
context: 'I need 10x to do what I want' — tension between ambition and capacity. Building the tool, running the company, planning a wedding, managing energy.

title: SQLite as an application file format
context: Using SQLite as the local data store — simple, robust, everywhere. Your data is a single file you can copy, backup, inspect.

title: electric-sql
context: Sync engine for local-first apps — Postgres to SQLite. Active sync, not just backup. Data lives locally, syncs to cloud when available.

title: You keep saving competitors but your vision is fundamentally different
context: Self-reflection: omnivore, linkwarden, mymind organize content. You want to understand a person. They file. You listen.

title: Readwise Reader
context: Read-it-later with spaced repetition of highlights. Smart but still consumption-focused. Helps you remember what you read, not why.

title: Every competitor is a filing cabinet with better UX. None of them ask: what does this collection of saves say about the person?
